subject.title: Fix automatic quota display priority for exhausted windows & Antigravity session preference

question: Should CodexBar intentionally show only Gemini session and weekly quotas in the Antigravity menu bar while leaving Claude/GPT quotas only in the dropdown card?
rationale: This is a user-visible provider-policy change beyond the exhausted-window bug fix, and the supplied discussion contains no maintainer approval for suppressing Claude/GPT from the menu bar.

options.title: Retain all-family status selection
options.body: Keep a supported automatic path that can surface constrained Claude/GPT quotas in the menu bar and preserves the current lane labels.

options.title: Approve Gemini-only menu status
options.body: Adopt Gemini session and weekly as the sole Antigravity menu-bar metrics, then migrate labels and add explicit compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Retain all-family status selection
recommendation.body: Keep a supported automatic path that can surface constrained Claude/GPT quotas in the menu bar and preserves the current lane labels.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available decision owner for a provider-display product contract; feature-history attribution could not be completed in the restricted read environment.
